serverInfo.description: Agent402 is a catalog of 500+ tools that AI agents find, pay for per request over x402 or MPP, and call with no account or API key. Flagships: live web search and cited answers, news, browser render, market data, speech-to-text and wallet-keyed memory; the rest via catalog.find. Settle in USDC via x402 or MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) on the same 402, or free via proof-of-work. The applied layer of Agentic Finance. Maintained by Havok Holdings LLC.
